mapper.sql: R.REQ_ID AS reqId, R.REQ_TITL AS reqTitl, R.REQ_CN AS reqCn, R.REQ_ORGNZT_ID AS reqOrgnztId, OG.ORGNZT_NM AS reqOrgnztNm, R.REQ_USER_ID AS reqUserId, R.REQ_USER_NM AS reqUserNm, R.REQ_DT AS reqDt, R.STATUS_CD AS statusCd, ST.CODE_NM AS statusNm, R.APRV_USER_ID AS aprvUserId, R.APRV_USER_NM AS aprvUserNm, R.APRV_DT AS aprvDt, R.RETURN_RSN AS returnRsn, R.SUIT_ID AS suitId, LS.CASE_NO AS caseNo, R.ATCH_FILE_ID AS atchFileId, R.REG_USER_ID AS regUserId, R.REG_DT AS regDt, R.UPD_USER_ID AS updUserId, R.UPD_DT AS updDt

FROM LAW_SUIT_REQ R LEFT OUTER JOIN COMTNORGNZTINFO OG ON OG.ORGNZT_ID = R.REQ_ORGNZT_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN COMTCCMMNDETAILCODE ST ON ST.CODE_ID = 'LAW_REQ_STATUS' AND ST.CODE = R.STATUS_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN LAW_SUIT LS ON LS.SUIT_ID = R.SUIT_ID AND LS.DEL_YN = 'N'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM LAW_SUIT_REQ R WHERE 1 = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE LAW_SUIT_REQ SET REQ_TITL = #{reqTitl, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, REQ_CN = #{reqCn, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, ATCH_FILE_ID = #{atchFileId, jdbcType=CHAR}, STATUS_CD = 'S001', UPD_USER_ID = #{updUserId}, UPD_DT = #{updDt} WHERE REQ_ID = #{reqId}

UPDATE LAW_SUIT_REQ SET STATUS_CD = #{statusCd}, APRV_USER_ID = #{aprvUserId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, APRV_USER_NM = #{aprvUserNm, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, APRV_DT = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), RETURN_RSN = #{returnRsn, jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE REQ_ID = #{reqId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM LAW_SUIT_REQ WHERE STATUS_CD = 'S001'

SELECT HIST_ID AS histId, REQ_ID AS reqId, STA_DT AS staDt, END_DT AS endDt, HIST_CN AS histCn, ATCH_FILE_ID AS atchFileId, SORT_ORDR AS sortOrdr FROM LAW_SUIT_REQ_HIST WHERE REQ_ID = #{reqId} ORDER BY SORT_ORDR, HIST_ID

SELECT HELPER_ID AS helperId, REQ_ID AS reqId, DEPT_NM AS deptNm, HELPER_NM AS helperNm, TEL AS tel, MOBILE AS mobile, EMAIL AS email, SORT_ORDR AS sortOrdr FROM LAW_SUIT_REQ_HELPER WHERE REQ_ID = #{reqId} ORDER BY SORT_ORDR, HELPER_ID
